content: BullMQ WorkerOptions: lockDuration (default 30000ms) is the lock TTL; lock is renewed automatically at lockRenewTime (~lockDuration/2) as long as the event loop is free to run the renewal timer. stalledInterval (default 30000ms) is how often the stalled-checker sweeps for jobs whose lock expired. maxStalledCount (default 1) caps recovery attempts before a job is failed outright. A hung fetch call (awaiting a promise, not blocking the event loop) still allows lock renewal to fire on schedule -- so lockDuration must be tuned relative to the actual AbortController timeout, not the event-loop-blocking case alone.
